categories.main_business_segments: Halo Microelectronics Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, and sales of analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits, focusing on power management chips and signal chain chips. Key product lines include DC/DC chips, lithium battery charging management chips, port protection and signal switching chips, voice coil motor driver chips, and sensor chips. The company serves consumer electronics, automotive electronics, communication, and storage sectors, with recent expansion into intelligent visual perception and sensor chip product lines through acquisitions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies such as high-performance DC/DC conversion, lithium battery fast charging, charge pump super fast charging, AC/DC conversion, and advanced analog integrated circuit modules. It also develops wireless charging, automotive-grade analog ICs, port protection and signal switching circuits, autofocus and optical image stabilization technologies, and capacitive multi-touch technology. Halo Micro operates under a fabless model, outsourcing wafer manufacturing and packaging/testing to foundries while focusing on chip design and R&D.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Halo Micro's primary customers include leading global smartphone brands such as Samsung, Xiaomi, Vivo, OPPO, Honor, Google, Logitech, and Lenovo, as well as automotive manufacturers including Audi, Hyundai, Kia, XPeng, Hongqi, Seres, and Changan. The company targets consumer electronics, automotive electronics, communication, storage, and AI server markets, with products integrated into mobile devices, wearables, notebooks, and automotive smart cockpit platforms.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with significant business in Hong Kong, South Korea, the United States, Singapore, and other international markets. It has subsidiaries and offices in these regions to support R&D, sales, logistics, and customer support. Overseas sales account for approximately 76.76% of total revenue, with the remainder from domestic Chinese markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Halo Micro operates as a fabless semiconductor design company, focusing on chip design and development while outsourcing wafer fabrication and packaging/testing to third-party foundries and subcontractors. It occupies the midstream position in the semiconductor supply chain, bridging chip design and downstream customers such as OEMs and ODMs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high-efficiency, high-precision, and high-reliability analog and mixed-signal chip development, with strong emphasis on power management, fast charging, automotive-grade chips, and intelligent visual perception technologies. It invests heavily in R&D, with over 46% of revenue allocated to research, and pursues inorganic growth through acquisitions like Zinitix and pending acquisition of Chengxinwei. Future R&D focuses include AI edge applications, automotive electronics, communication, storage, and expanding product portfolios to compete with international leaders.
categories.revenue_model: Halo Micro generates revenue primarily through the sale of semiconductor chips and related integrated circuit products. Sales are conducted via direct sales and distributor channels, with a majority of revenue derived from distributor sales. The company also earns income from technology licensing and investment dividends, but product sales remain the core revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic supplier of power management and signal chain chips in China, competing with international giants like Texas Instruments, Analog Devices, Infineon, and NXP. While global analog chip markets are dominated by these established players, Halo Micro is rapidly growing its market share domestically and expanding internationally through technology innovation and strategic acquisitions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Halo Micro reported total revenue of approximately RMB 545.5 million, representing a 38.58% increase year-over-year. Despite revenue growth, the company recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 290.6 million, reflecting increased R&D, management, and sales expenses as well as inventory impairment. The company has total assets of around RMB 1.81 billion and net assets of RMB 1.48 billion, with a workforce of 345 employees including 212 in R&D. The company is in a rapid growth phase, expanding product lines and market presence.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Halo Micro emphasizes its advanced proprietary technologies delivering high efficiency, precision, and reliability in analog and mixed-signal chips. Its products are recognized for superior transient response, power efficiency, compact size, and robust protection features, enabling integration into high-end consumer electronics and automotive applications. The company’s strategic acquisitions and international R&D talent pool further enhance its ability to offer comprehensive, innovative chip solutions that meet diverse customer needs and compete with global leaders.
